history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration formulate formal guidelines for the management of funds with negative cash pool balances and that it implement a mechanism for the periodic review of funds with negative cash pool balances.
history.administration_response: The Administration conducts a monthly review of cash balances to identify any funds with negative cash balances and informs managers of those negative cash balances to enable them to take corrective action. Formal guidelines will be finalized by the end of 2025.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration conducts a monthly review of the cash balances of each fund, when negative cash balances are identified, managers of the funds are informed to enable them to take corrective action. Because of control mechanisms within Umoja, the instances of negative cash balances in recent years have significantly decreased. In addition, the Board received a file from the Financial Analytics and Reporting Section showing that only two funds had had negative balances at the end of 2023 and 2024. The Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
